puja.label: पूजा / Devotional Worship Services
puja.intro: Individual and community worship services conducted with strict scriptural authenticity to invoke divine grace.

items.text: Dedicated worship including Ganapati Puja, Lakshmi Puja, Saraswati Puja, Shiva Puja, Vishnu Puja, and Devi Puja.
Sacred worship honoring Gomata (the cow) on auspicious occasions, recognizing the presence of all Devas and Mahalakshmi within her.
Honoring the Guru lineage (Parampara) and seeking blessings for spiritual illumination.
Devotional worship conducted for family prosperity, peace, and thanksgiving.
Worship to harmonize planetary influences in personal horoscopes.
Specialized evening worship invoking the protective and benevolent grace of Devi.
Special worship invoking the blessings of Lord Ayyappa (Sastha) for protection and discipline.
Sacred geometric worship of the Sri Chakra for spiritual elevation and energy alignment.
Intensive chanting of Sri Rudram accompanied by Abhishekam for deep spiritual cleansing.
Targeted remedial ceremonies designed to address the spiritual root causes of ailments (such as Asthma, Blood Pressure, and Rheumatism).

nitya.label: नित्यसेवा / Daily Temple Worship
nitya.intro: Daily worship forms the spiritual foundation of campus life, bringing peace, purity, and divine grace.

items.text: Sacred awakening chants and prayers at dawn to begin the day with divine grace.
Ceremonial offering of sacred lamps accompanied by devotional hymns.
Ritual bathing of the deities with sacred liquids and chanting of holy names (Ashtothara / Sahasranama).
Offering of sanctified lamps and wholesome vegetarian offerings (Prasadam) to the Divine.
Daily recitation of Vedic mantras by Purohits as an offering to the Divine, seeking divine blessings for peace, prosperity, and the well-being of all.

homa.label: होमः / Sacred Fire Sacrifices
homa.intro: Fire is revered as the divine messenger carrying prayers and offerings to celestial forces for physical, material, and spiritual protection.

items.text: Performed to remove obstacles, clear laziness, and ensure focus in studies, business, and daily pursuits.
Invokes blessings from the nine celestial bodies for peace, balance, growth, and overall prosperity.
Performed for longevity, vitality, and well-being.
Performed to overcome health emergencies, accidental threats, and severe physical ailments.
Potent ritual to vanquish negative energies, alleviate enmity, and resolve major operational or business blocks.
Performed for wealth, financial stability, and spiritual abundance.
Performed for matrimonial harmony, removing delays in marriage, and family peace.
Powerful fire ritual for fulfilling noble desires, overcoming obstacles, and establishing Dharmic life.
Dedicated to Lord Dhanvantari for health, healing, and freedom from chronic illness.
Performed to invoke Lord Shiva's blessings for profound spiritual purification and cosmic protection.
Invokes the Goddess of Knowledge for memory retention, academic excellence, and artistic mastery.

samskaras.label: संस्कारः / Life-Cycle Rites of Passage
samskaras.intro: Sacred rites of passage performed under qualified Acharyas to purify, guide, and bless human existence at every key milestone.

items.text: Sacred naming ceremony for newborns.
First ceremonial feeding of solid sanctified food to infants.
First haircut ceremony symbolizing cleanliness and spiritual growth.
Formal initiation of a child into learning and the alphabet.
Sacred thread ceremony initiating young seekers into Vedic study and spiritual discipline.
Traditional Vedic marriage ceremony sanctifying family life.
Celebration and thanksgiving ceremony on completing 60 years of life.
Grand milestone celebration and blessings upon reaching 80 years of age.
Special remedial peace ceremonies (such as Nakshatra Shanthi, Ayushya Shanthi) to remove astrological doshas.

yagna.label: यज्ञः / Collective Ceremonies for Universal Welfare
yagna.intro: Yagnas represent the highest form of Vedic action (Yajnohi Sreshta thamam Karma) performed collectively for societal welfare, environmental purity, and global peace.

items.text: A sacred Vedic ritual in which Purohits chant the Samhita Veda mantras and offer Svaha during the Yajna. The purpose is to preserve Vedic traditions and invoke divine blessings for spiritual growth, peace, harmony, and the well-being of all.
Massive, multi-day sacred ceremony for universal peace, national protection, and removing large-scale societal obstacles.
Collective worship of the Divine Mother for strength, protection, and overcoming adversity.
Grand-scale collective recitations of Sri Rudram for cosmic harmony and environmental balance.
Grand collective offerings to Lord Ganesha for auspicious beginnings and universal prosperity.
Collective fire offerings for global harmony and balance in natural forces.
Collective worship for global peace, economic prosperity, and spiritual preservation.

AROGHYADANAM.name: AROGHYADANAM

story.overview: Established to preserve, practice, and propagate the timeless wisdom of the Vedas and the rich spiritual heritage of Bharat through the unbroken oral tradition of the Guru–Shishya Parampara. Operates on the conviction that education, food, healthcare, and spiritual guidance are fundamental pillars of human development
extras: 100% Free Residential Provision: Provides comprehensive residential facilities—including free boarding, lodging, quality education, healthcare, and cultural enrichment—so students can focus entirely on Vedic and academic growth

Institutional Wings Managed by the Trust: Vedavani Pathashala: The core residential Gurukulam delivering dual-path education (Vedic studies alongside recognized NIOS academic certificates) and Panchamukhi Shikshana
Shodhasamsthanam (Research Division): Research institute dedicated to Vedic science (Veda Vijnana), rare manuscript collection, palm-leaf preservation, and digital archiving
Vanaprastham Wing (OLD AGE HOME) : A dedicated sanctuary providing elders with spiritual security (Abhayadānam), peaceful living, and intergenerational mentorship with Gurukulam students
Community Outreach(E-Jnana-kendram): Conducting online and offline Veda chanting (E - Deva Śruti) and Sanskrit language (E - Deva Vāṇī) classes, teacher training, and rural outreach

vision: We aspire to bring ancient wisdom into modern life and nurture a society rooted in Dharma, compassion, spiritual awareness, and selfless service, for the well-being of all.
mission: To preserve, practice, and propagate the timeless heritage of Sanatana Dharma, Vedic wisdom, Sanskrit, and Bharatiya Knowledge Systems by providing free education, spiritual guidance, elder care, research, and community service for the welfare of society.

gurukulam.GURUKULAM: Authentic residential education based on the Guru–Shishya Parampara, featuring a disciplined daily routine (Dinacharya) starting at 5:00 AM (Brahma Muhurta) with meditation, yoga, prayers, and Vedic studies.
gurukulam.GURUKULAM OVERVIEW (Where Wisdom Becomes: An authentic residential learning environment rooted in the ancient Guru–Shishya Parampara, dedicated to preserving and transmitting Vedic wisdom, Sanskrit, Bharatiya Knowledge Systems, and modern academic excellence. Education is experienced as an immersive way of life that shapes character, intellect, physical health, and spiritual awareness.
gurukulam.GURU–SHISHYA PARAMPARA (Sacred Bond): Personalized learning direct from experienced Acharyas built upon mutual trust, respect, devotion, and discipline. The Guru acts as a mentor, philosopher, and role model who shapes character and awakens the student's highest potential.
gurukulam.RESIDENTIAL LIFE & CAMPUS ENVIRONMENT: A close-knit spiritual family providing comfortable accommodation, nutritious Sattvic vegetarian meals, regular healthcare, serene spaces for meditation and Yoga, and a disciplined environment that teaches self-reliance, cooperation, and gratitude.
gurukulam.DISCIPLINED DAILY ROUTINE (Dinacharya): Balanced daily schedule beginning at 5:00 AM (Brahma Muhurta):• Morning: Pre-dawn awakening, silent meditation, gentle Yoga, Pranayama, Sandhyavandana, and Vedic chanting.• Daytime: Academic classes, Vedic studies, Sanskrit learning, practical skills, and Krishi/Go Seva.• Evening/Night: Physical sports, evening prayers, devotional singing (Bhajans), guided self-study, reflection, and early rest.
gurukulam.POSITIVE DISCIPLINE & CHARACTER BUILDING: Discipline is approached as a pathway to freedom and inner strength through positive guidance. Students cultivate punctuality, cleanliness, honest speech, ethical conduct, simplicity, and respect for Gurus and elders.
gurukulam.VEDIC STUDIES (Preserving the Oral Tradi: Systematic training in the sacred oral tradition focusing on the Rigveda, Yajurveda, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, Vedangas, and Dharma Shastras. Students master precise pronunciation (Śikṣā), intonation (Svara), rhythm, memory techniques, and the Ghana Patha tradition.
gurukulam.SANSKRIT STUDIES (Deva Vāṇī): Comprehensive Sanskrit education covering reading, writing, speaking, grammar (Vyākaraṇa), vocabulary, classical poetry, drama, composition, and scriptural interpretation. Focuses on Subhashitas, Gita, Ramayana, Mahabharata, and spoken Sanskrit fluency.
gurukulam.DUAL-PATH EDUCATION MODEL & NIOS CERTIFI: Unique dual-path model where traditional Gurukula teaching leads, integrated with modern academics. Students receive nationally recognized National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) study certificates in Mathematics, Science, Social Science, English, Information Technology, and Environmental Studies. This empowers graduates to pursue university degrees (Engineering, Science, Arts) or self-reliant careers.
gurukulam.MULTILINGUAL PROFICIENCY: Building fluency across four languages: Samskritam, Kannada, English, and Hindi, developing public speaking, creative writing, translation, and presentation skills.
gurukulam.Panchamukhi Shikshana:
Inspired by the timeless principles of the Gurukula tradition, Panchamukhi Shikshana is a unique five-dimensional educational framework combining India's ancient knowledge systems with essential skills required to thrive in the modern world. It shapes the mind, body, character, intellect, and spirit for holistic development. 1. Veda (Scriptures & Chanting), Systematic training in Vedic chanting, scriptural study, Sanskrit pronunciation, and the Guru–Shishya tradition under experienced Acharyas. Includes the study of Rigveda, Yajurveda, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, Vedangas, Subhashitas, Dharma Shastras, and Vedic Philosophy. 2. Yoga (Asanas & Meditation) - Every day at the Gurukulam begins with Yoga practices including Yogāsanas, Prāṇāyāma, Meditation, Sūrya Namaskāra, relaxation techniques, mindfulness, prayer, and silent reflection. • Mind-Body Benefits: Promotes physical fitness, emotional stability, concentration, self-confidence, self-control, positive thinking, stress management, inner peace, and resilience to face life's challenges with wisdom. 3. Vijnana (Science & Math) - Encourages scientific curiosity while developing an appreciation for India's remarkable historical contributions to mathematics, astronomy, medicine, agriculture, architecture, metallurgy, and philosophy. • Critical Thinking & Modern Integration: Teaches students to ask questions, think critically, solve problems creatively, and apply scientific principles responsibly. Combines Vedic knowledge with modern academic subjects (Mathematics, Science, Social Sciences, Information Technology) through recognized NIOS certification. 4. Krishi (Organic Agriculture & Go Seva) - An education in sustainability, responsibility, and living in harmony with nature. Includes practical training in organic farming, natural agriculture, tree plantation, water conservation, soil management, herbal gardens, and seed preservation.
• Go Seva & Dignity of Labour: Active participation in Go Seva (cow protection, daily feeding, and care) in the campus Goshala. Teaches patience, gratitude, environmental stewardship, and the dignity of physical labour. 5. Kala Kaushalya (Traditional Arts & Crafts) - Nurtures artistic excellence, cultural appreciation, and practical life skills by introducing students to India's rich artistic traditions, ensuring knowledge is expressed through aesthetics and joyful creativity. • The 64 Kalas & Performing Arts: Exploration of elements of the traditional 64 Bharatiya Kalas to promote observation, communication, design thinking, and practical intelligence. Includes systematic training in classical music, Bhajans, devotional singing, Sanskrit drama, traditional crafts, and cultural performances that build confidence, teamwork, leadership, and cultural pride.
gurukulam.100% FREE RESIDENTIAL PROVISION: Guided by the belief that education, food, and medicine are fundamental rights, all residential education, boarding, lodging, Sattvic food (Annadhanam), uniforms, study materials, and healthcare are provided completely free of cost for every student.
gurukulam.STUDENT LIFE & EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITI: Vibrant student life including educational tours, spiritual pilgrimages (Tirtha Yatra), temple service, cultural festivals, youth leadership camps, debate competitions, and community outreach initiatives.
gurukulam.Languages Taught: Multilingual proficiency in Samskritam, Kannada, English, and Hindi.
